cards.example_en: Lifeguards save swimmers who drift too far from shore.
cards.example_zh: 救生员救起那些漂得离岸太远的游泳者。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：使安全；获得
cards.example_en: Riders secure their bikes with a lock near the gate.
cards.example_zh: 骑车的人在大门附近用锁把自行车锁好。

cards.example_en: I can see the mountains from our upstairs window.
cards.example_zh: 从我们楼上的窗户能看见群山。

cards.example_en: Graduates often seek part-time work during the summer.
cards.example_zh: 毕业生常常在夏天寻求兼职工作。

cards.example_en: I will send Grandma a photo of the snowman.
cards.example_zh: 我要给奶奶发送一张雪人的照片。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：服务；端上
cards.example_en: Volunteers serve hot porridge at the winter fair.
cards.example_zh: 志愿者在冬季义卖会上端上热粥。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：放置；设置
cards.example_en: He will set the plates on the table before dinner.
cards.example_zh: 他会在晚饭前把盘子放到桌上。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：坐；坐下
cards.example_en: Let's sit under the tree while we eat lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我们吃午饭时坐到那棵树下去吧。

cards.example_en: Babies sleep better when the room stays quiet.
cards.example_zh: 房间保持安静时，婴儿睡得更好。

cards.example_en: Teenagers often spend too much money on snacks.
cards.example_zh: 青少年常常在零食上花费太多钱。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：站；站立
cards.example_en: We stand behind the white line while the train passes.
cards.example_zh: 火车经过时，我们站在白线后面。

cards.example_en: The film will start at seven in the school hall.
cards.example_zh: 电影将于七点在学校礼堂开始。

cards.example_en: Can you stay for dinner after the piano lesson?
cards.example_zh: 钢琴课结束后，你能留下来吃晚饭吗？

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：粘住；坚持
cards.example_en: Wet leaves stick to our shoes on autumn paths.
cards.example_zh: 在秋天的小路上，湿叶子会粘在我们的鞋上。

cards.example_en: Candidates submit their forms to the office by Thursday.
cards.example_zh: 考生须在星期四前把表格提交到办公室。
